hints.text: Absolute value is the distance from $0$. Find the value of each expression before you compare them.
$-7$ is $7$ units from $0$, so $|-7| = 7$. Likewise $|3| = 3$. Now compare those two distances.

explanation: Evaluate each absolute value first, since it stands for a distance from $0$.
$-7$ is $7$ units from $0$, so $|-7| = 7$. And $3$ is $3$ units from $0$, so $|3| = 3$.
Compare the results: $7 > 3$. So $|-7|$ is greater than $|3|$, even though $-7$ itself is less than $3$.
